description: A PHP class defining a dashboard widget for displaying an RSS feed of the OpenX Blog, including methods for retrieving statistics data related to ad impressions and clicks over a specified time period.

classes.name: OA_Dashboard_Widget_GraphOAP
classes.description: A dashboard widget class for displaying a graph with statistics from ad impressions and clicks, extending OA_Dashboard_Widget_Graph.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget and sets cache lifetime, optionally loading data if required.

methods.name: getCacheId
methods.description: Returns a cache identifier array, including account-specific information.

methods.name: getStats
methods.description: Retrieves ad impression and click statistics over the past week, grouped by day, considering account permissions.
